title: [DEV] AAPSclient misses downloads
symptom: AAPSclient misses downloads from Nightscout: data is in NS but won't download, missing data won't backfill even after force closing and clearing cache. Specific missing items include Meal Bolus, Carbs, TBR, and Insulin Change.
evidence_quote: Data is in NS, but won't download. Missing data won't backfill, even if I force close AAPSclient, delete cache and restart NSClient.
